<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg id="chroma-palette-svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 530" width="1200" height="530">
    <rect id="palette-background" width="1200" height="530" fill="#FFFFFF" />
    
                    <g class="palette-swatch-group" data-index="0" data-hex="#1E3A8A" transform="translate(0, 0)">
                        <rect class="palette-swatch-box" data-index="0" data-hex="#1E3A8A" width="240" height="460" fill="#1E3A8A" />
                        <text class="palette-swatch-hex" x="120" y="416" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#1E3A8A</text>
                        <text class="palette-swatch-name" x="120" y="440" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Aegean Deep</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g class="palette-swatch-group" data-index="1" data-hex="#3B82F6" transform="translate(240, 0)">
                        <rect class="palette-swatch-box" data-index="1" data-hex="#3B82F6" width="240" height="460" fill="#3B82F6" />
                        <text class="palette-swatch-hex" x="120" y="416" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#3B82F6</text>
                        <text class="palette-swatch-name" x="120" y="440" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Cycladic Sky</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g class="palette-swatch-group" data-index="2" data-hex="#F8FAFC" transform="translate(480, 0)">
                        <rect class="palette-swatch-box" data-index="2" data-hex="#F8FAFC" width="240" height="460" fill="#F8FAFC" />
                        <text class="palette-swatch-hex" x="120" y="416" fill="#0F172A" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#F8FAFC</text>
                        <text class="palette-swatch-name" x="120" y="440" fill="#0F172A" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Caldera White</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g class="palette-swatch-group" data-index="3" data-hex="#F97316" transform="translate(720, 0)">
                        <rect class="palette-swatch-box" data-index="3" data-hex="#F97316" width="240" height="460" fill="#F97316" />
                        <text class="palette-swatch-hex" x="120" y="416" fill="#0F172A" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#F97316</text>
                        <text class="palette-swatch-name" x="120" y="440" fill="#0F172A" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Oia Sunset</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g class="palette-swatch-group" data-index="4" data-hex="#BE123C" transform="translate(960, 0)">
                        <rect class="palette-swatch-box" data-index="4" data-hex="#BE123C" width="240" height="460" fill="#BE123C" />
                        <text class="palette-swatch-hex" x="120" y="416" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#BE123C</text>
                        <text class="palette-swatch-name" x="120" y="440" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Bougainvillea</text>
                    </g>
                
    <rect id="palette-footer-bg" y="460" width="1200" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF" />
    <text id="palette-prompt-text" x="24" y="492" fill="#0F172A" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">Sunset over Santorini</text>
    <text id="palette-meta-text" x="24" y="514" fill="#64748B" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13">ChromaAI Palette • #1E3A8A  #3B82F6  #F8FAFC  #F97316  #BE123C</text>
</svg>
